craft_notes: Sthāyin: fearlessness (#2 fearless: māyā made NATURAL, face seen — the fearlessness is of seeing māyā AS nature). Rows: row 2 (see→calmed). Close: well (suvibhūta — well-being-as-adverb: becoming-Bhairava WELL — the adverb kept, it's odd and good). Rejected: 'maya conquered' — killed: māyā natural kept (svabhāvā bhūtā — MĀYĀ'S OWN NATURE is māyā: the tautology is doctrine); 'face of God' — killed: own-face kept (svamukha — his face AND one's: the double kept open).

lines: calmed senses, own state: Bhairava-natured well.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvatra bhairavo bhāvaḥ sāmānyeṣv api gocaraḥ | na ca tadvyatirekteṇa paro 'stīty advayā gatiḥ

reads_against.argmap: Where is Bhairava-state? → Bhairava-state is immanent everywhere — nothing beyond it, nondual.
c1_essence: Bhairava everywhere in common things: nondual, no beyond.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra with śānta undertow (resolve laid quiet)
